pages.notes: VR ferromagnetic toothed rotor seeks minimum reluctance/max flux. Eight paired stator poles A/B/C/D surround six rotor teeth; adjacent ideal axes45 versus teeth60 gives15 degree nearest alignment step. Phase means independent stator winding. Holding torque is energized stationary resistance to displacement, not the confusing reversing-spindle clause.
